description: This file defines an enum 'NthDayType' representing different types of days within a period, including specific days (ONE, TWO, etc.), last day, on day, and invalid. It provides methods for retrieving enum instances from integer values, and for checking properties like 'isInvalid', 'isLastDay', and 'isOnDay'.

classes.name: NthDayType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different types of days within a month or period, with methods to map integers to enum instances and check day properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding NthDayType enum value, defaulting to INVALID if no match found.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks whether the current enum instance represents an invalid day type.

methods.name: isLastDay
methods.description: Checks whether the current enum instance represents the last day.

methods.name: isOnDay
methods.description: Checks whether the current enum instance represents the on-day.
